title: A Dress for Midsummer
offer: Midsummer is coming, and you need dresses! Bring me two crates of wool, the red madder from Solby, and the silver clasp which Hrafn the smith makes for a few pieces of silver.

steps.say: Good wool. Now the red dye.

steps.load_say: Madder roots from my garden: they dye the wool red as a sunset.

steps.say: A clasp shaped like a little bird. Mind it, it is silver!
One night of weaving, and here they are: two red dresses with silver clasps. You will be the prettiest at midsummer!

fact: Red dye came from the roots of madder, blue from woad, yellow from weld.
